description: Authoritative HD key-derivation golden vectors. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH that BOTH wallets must match: Android (ai.agentwallet.hd.HDWallet) and iOS (StellarService). The Stellar address is SLIP-10 ed25519 at m/44'/148'/0' derived from the BIP39 seed with an EMPTY passphrase. Values were computed independently with the SEP-0005 reference library 'stellar-hd-wallet' (not from either app), so a mismatch on either platform is a real bug. Drift here means the two apps would compute DIFFERENT wallet addresses from the same secret phrase = funds sent to the wrong/uncontrolled address. Enforced by tests/protocol/hd-derivation-contract.test.mjs (pins both platform tests to these values), apps/ios/VelarumPayTests/HDDerivationGoldenTests.swift, and apps/android/.../HDDerivationGoldenTest.java.
